channel.title: The Grant Desk - Artist Residencies, Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, US, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Artist Residencies, Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, US, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 10 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

item.title: 1 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact residency - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
• American Academy in Berlin: Berlin Prize Fellowship 2027-28
    https://www.americanacademy.de/apply/apply-for-a-fellowship/
    American Academy in Berlin · deadline 25 Sep 2026 · Monthly stipend of USD 5,000, plus roundtrip airfare, accommodation at or near the Hans Arnhold Center, partial board, in-house library services and professional networking opportunities. Roughly two dozen fellowships awarded each year. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 1 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact residency - week of 27 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Creative Residency at Bloedel Reserve: Class of 2027
    https://bloedelreserve.slideroom.com/#/login/program/88209
    Bloedel Reserve · deadline Closed 01 Sep 2026 · USD 22 application fee. Furnished private house on the grounds with linens, stocked kitchen, wi-fi, laundry and use of a smart car; an electric piano is available. Domestic residents receive a USD 1,000 stipend. International residents receive no stipend and may instead submit up to USD 1,000 of expenses for reimbursement. Residents pay for their own meals and their own travel to Bainbridge Island. There is no dedicated studio; residents work in the house.

item.title: 2 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact residencies - week of 06 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Ucross General Residency (All Disciplines): Spring 2027
    https://www.ucrossfoundation.org/residency-program.html
    Ucross Foundation · deadline Closed 15 Jul 2026 · No charge for the residency; living accommodations, meals, and work space provided. USD 40 application fee.
  • Kaatsbaan Subsidized Residencies
    https://kaatsbaan.org/subsidized-residencies
    Kaatsbaan Cultural Park · deadline Rolling / undated · Generously subsidized residency; includes hotel-style on-campus rooms, locally sourced meals, and access to studios, a 160-seat black box theater, and a 153-acre Hudson Valley campus. No artist stipend.

item.title: 1 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact residency - week of 01 Jun 2026
item.description:
• Grand Canyon Conservancy Residency 2027 (Artist / Astronomer / Environmental Educator)
    https://www.grandcanyon.org/experience-grand-canyon/residency-program
    Grand Canyon Conservancy (Grand Canyon National Park) · deadline Closed 15 Jul 2026 · Free on-site accommodation in the park, financial support (honorarium/stipend; amount varies by track and session - confirm on the track-specific page), plus marketing/exposure through the Conservancy and the National Park. Alumni network access. No application fee. Three tracks (Artist / Astronomer / Environmental Educator) - apply to one track per cycle.
